stem: Which statement describes what will most likely happen during Step 4?

options.label: A
options.text: The substrates will bind together to form a product, and the enzyme will be unchanged.

options.label: B
options.text: The substrates will bind together to form a product, and the enzyme will be denatured.

options.label: C
options.text: The enzymes and substrates will all bind together to form one product.

options.label: D
options.text: The enzyme will become the product and both substrates will be released.

visual_elements:
The diagram illustrates a biological process.
Step 1: Two substrate pieces approach the enzyme.
Step 2: Substrates fit into the enzyme active site.
Step 3: Substrates are bound tightly in the active site of the enzyme.
Step 4: ?
